module: Flowgraph node "Pause Game" (category once_p_duration, author BeamNG, tags pause/freeze/halt/stop/interrupt). Pauses the simulation via simTimeAuthority.pause. The action is deferred to _afterTrigger (after all nodes have triggered in the frame).
notes: Bug: the input pin "value" ("whether the game should be paused") is never read. workOnce always sets _pauseGame to true, so the node only pauses, never resumes.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the internal flag to false.

workOnce.desc: Requests the pause (flag set to true).

_afterTrigger.desc: If requested and the game is not already paused, calls simTimeAuthority.pause(true), then resets the flag to false.
